notes.title: HUNTER CHRONICLES: PLAYABLE BATTLE TEASER IS OUT NOW!
notes.content:
While many have already gotten to play this small beta through our Gamejolt page, we're excited to announce it has finally been approved for Steam as well! You can go to the link below to download it into your own steam library!

We decided to create this small playable teaser of the battle system as proof of our work and dedication to getting this game out - while it's not much for now, we hope it's an exciting enough preview of things to come!

Click the link below to check it out!

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3359600/Hunter_Chronicles_Tara_and_Vyn__Playable_Battle_Teaser/

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

This teaser features 6 increasingly more difficult battles utilizing three early game enemies, and three extra challenges once you beat them! All three of Tara and Vyn's basic attacks are included, as well as two Duo Attacks - more elaborate moves that require both characters to perform!

(Unfortunately, we ran out of time to code in the practice and demo for the Duo Attacks, but we hope they are intuitive enough to perform...)

(Keep in mind this Beta uses old graphics and doesn't reflect how the final product will look - if you'd like to see some of our current work, please support the game's development on Ko-Fi! We offer sneak peeks into the game's development at even the lowest tiers!)

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

If you like what you see here, and you'd like to help support the game's development (we really need it!) Visit our Ko-Fi page! Any bit helps and is appreciated immensely!
